title: Lisle 17232 Right Angle Funnel, One Size, Factory
description:
About this item
Useful for adding brake fluid to master cylinders on mini-vans, adding gear lube to differentials, filling the DEF reservoir on GM Duramax diesels as well as other applications
The funnel mouth is 3.5" outer diameter and the spout is .7" outer diameter
Item Package Dimension: 12.99L x 4.72W x 3.15H inches
Item Package Weight - 0.1 Pounds
Item Package Quantity - 1
Product Type - FUNNEL

reviews_1s: Paid five bucks extra to get the caps that seal the ends of the funnel. It arrived without the small bottom cap. What a waste.Have a Jeep Grand Cherokee and haven’t been able to find a funnel to use with a gas can. Was hoping this one would go down in the tank far enough, but it didn’t. Isn’t flexible, wasn’t spill resistant for my use.This funnel will not pour from a 90' angle. I needed one to refill my transmission/hydraulic fluids in my John Deer tractor because the transmission refill plug is partially under the seat. This funnel will not work for that unless you "catch" with another secondary funnel. It's still a "funnel" and might work for something else but I'm giving it one star for misleading me into a waste of money. Look closely at the tip and you'll see (as I should have) that this never actually completes a 90' turn. If they would have called it 75' or whatever it actually is . . . I would give it 3 stars.Agree with the other review, one has to squat down low, move away tree branches, hold funnel with one hand in perfect position into the tree stand (tougher than you’d think in this position) while pouring with the other hand. It’ll work better with two ppl but I always dreaded having to add water to the Christmas tree. Will look for one with a long extension. Can see where this would be great for other uses, just not a Christmas tree.This funnel didn’t work well for my boat.
